title: The residual requires its declared valuation class
statement: For a finite declared lattice and a normalized monotone valuation whose mutual valuation is monotone separately in both arguments, the existing premium agrees with the residual under the paper hypotheses. Shannon H is admissible; Z -> I(Y;Z) is not universally admissible, as the XOR countermodel shows.
boundary: Finite checks certify only the supplied finite table; no universal admissibility is inferred for N. Authorship equality still requires the full-support lemma or a separate common-part proof. Support-with-zeros and N admissibility remain open.

paper.scope: Consume the cited theorem under its stated valuation class; finite API vectors check implementation correspondence, not a new proof of the cited theorem.
